scope: Development hypotheses chosen after earlier development comparisons; not independently validated
semanticOutput: uint8 HxW ADE150 at the exact same upright source grid, no resize inside merger
skyObservationMask: semantic output == 2; identical to evaluated fused map. Positive n640 override plus retained base sky can increase sky false positives.
standaloneN640Sky: comparison output only, not used as separate downstream mask
personCount: object detector observations only; semantic person area is not added to box count
